profile.name: Gnosis Chain EEZ Rollup0 Compatibility Host Profile

eez_rollup_id.reason: A settlement host is reserved as MAINNET_ROLLUP_ID 0 in the Rollup0 compatibility binding and is not a registered rollup.

genesis_commitment.issue: Pin the Chiado chain-spec or genesis commitment used by conforming Rollup0 settlement clients.

value.validation: The historical Rollup0 EEZ deployment and every transaction that invokes eez-evm@0.1-rollup0 must execute in a canonical Chiado block at or after this timestamp. A later canonical Chiado fork is valid only while it retains these opcode semantics.

host_profile.reason: This profile is the settlement host.

host_network.reason: This profile is the settlement host and makes no recursive EEZ settlement claim.

host_chain_id.reason: The host chain ID is chain_identity.eip155_chain_id.

eez_contract.issue: Pin the canonical Chiado eez-evm@0.1-rollup0 EEZ address, runtime-bytecode hash, deployment transaction, and authenticated deployment record.

manager_contract.reason: Each consuming rollup profile owns its manager deployment identity.

proof_system_contracts.reason: Each consuming rollup profile owns its proof-system deployments and verification policy.

deployment_block.issue: Pin the canonical Chiado eez-evm@0.1-rollup0 deployment block number and hash.

settlement_rule.value: Chiado executes eez-evm@0.1-rollup0 for Rollup0. Host evidence is the exact canonical transaction receipt and ordered log occurrence from the profile-pinned historical EEZ deployment; matching only a root value or event signature elsewhere in the block is insufficient. Rollup0 separately defines which genuine occurrence establishes its endpoint.
settlement_rule.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §3.1 and §3.5; Rollup0 Network Specification §0

finality_rule.value: Use the canonical Chiado finalized consensus view; EEZ adds no independent host finality.
finality_rule.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §3.1 and §3.5

value.validation: Use the gasLimit of the canonical Chiado execution payload and validate it under the canonical Chiado execution chain configuration active at that block. EEZ applies no override or constant gas limit.

block_gas_limit.source: Gnosis Chain Chiado canonical execution configuration linked from https://docs.gnosischain.com/about/networks/chiado

value.base_fee_source: baseFeePerGas in the canonical Chiado execution payload
value.gas_usage_source: gasUsed and gasLimit in the canonical Chiado execution payload and its parent
value.blob_fee_model: Canonical Chiado EIP-4844 rules active for the block
value.validation: Validate transaction fees, base-fee transition, blob-gas fields, and blob fees using the canonical Chiado execution chain configuration active at the block. EEZ applies no independent fee rule.

fee_market.source: Gnosis Chain EIP-1559 and Dencun specifications: https://docs.gnosischain.com/about/specs/hard-forks/eip-1559 and https://docs.gnosischain.com/about/specs/hard-forks/dencun

fee_recipient.reason: The EEZ host profile does not select the host consensus fee recipient.

eez_predeploys.reason: EEZ is deployed as host contracts on Chiado; consumer L2 predeploys belong to each rollup profile.

system_address.reason: SYSTEM_ADDRESS is an L2 inbound-delivery choice.

system_transaction_envelope.reason: System transactions execute on an EEZ rollup, not on the settlement host.

sequencing_model.value: Canonical Gnosis Chiado consensus and block production

sequencing_authority.value: Chiado consensus validators/builders; EEZ grants no host sequencing authority

atomic_inclusion.issue: Pin a supported builder, relay, access, or wrapper mechanism that guarantees whole, ordered, same-block Rollup0 bundle inclusion and its failure semantics, authenticates the exact postAndVerifyBatch caller and calldata including both transient prefix counts, and prevents modified proof reuse or front-running.

max_user_transactions_per_bundle.reason: Bundle size is selected by the Rollup0 profile; it is not a Chiado protocol parameter.

proof_routing_mitigation.reason: Rollup0 selects its binding-specific mitigation. This host profile identifies the corresponding atomic-inclusion capability under GC-R0-ATOMIC-INCLUSION.

model.reason: The Rollup0 network profile and manager select the proof model.

allowed_proof_systems_and_vkeys.reason: The Rollup0 network profile and manager select these values.

threshold.reason: The Rollup0 network profile and manager select its threshold.

requirement.reason: The Rollup0 profile owns its data-availability requirement.

channel.reason: The Rollup0 profile selects its data-availability channel.

codec.reason: The Rollup0 profile selects the payload codec carried by host calldata.

derivation_rule.reason: Derivation is a Rollup0 network rule.

manager_authority.reason: The Rollup0 profile owns its manager authority and recovery policy.

upgrade_policy.issue: Publish ownership, historical EEZ contract upgrade, and emergency procedures for the Chiado Rollup0 deployment.

reorg_and_emergency_rule.value: Before finality, Rollup0 rewinds exact receipt and ordered-log occurrences removed or reordered by canonical Chiado reorgs, then applies its own network-profile recovery rule. Only the canonical Chiado finalized view is final.
reorg_and_emergency_rule.source: Gnosis Chain EEZ Network Specification §3.5 and Rollup0 Network Specification §6
